rows.claim: round_money now rounds half away from zero (2.675 -> 2.68, 0.125 -> 0.13).
rows.evidence: The sed changed ROUND_HALF_EVEN to ROUND_HALF_UP (Decimal quantize, which rounds half away from zero). The pytest run shows test_half_up (2.675->2.68), test_small_half (0.125->0.13) and test_negative_half passing; only test_bankers_rounding_compat failed with 0.13 vs 0.12.

rows.claim: test_bankers_rounding_compat contradicts test_small_half and cannot pass at the same time.
rows.evidence: The test file output shows test_small_half asserts round_money(0.125) == 0.13 and test_bankers_rounding_compat asserts round_money(0.125) == 0.12. The same input cannot give both results. Pytest shows only the banker's test failing after the fix.
